name: Vesna Bergstrom-Konate
role: Prototype theft and corporate tech acquisition — tech retriever
location: Whitecap — lakefront district, tourist traps over criminal infrastructure, near Wacker and State
description:
Vesna Bergstrom-Konate is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 28, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left him with skills and night terrors in equal measure. He works as a tech retriever out of Whitecap, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Vesna Bergstrom-Konate has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Vesna Bergstrom-Konate sends anonymous tips to Meridian 88 law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: Vesna Bergstrom-Konate is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A corporate black site Vesna Bergstrom-Konate once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
Vesna Bergstrom-Konate intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Vesna Bergstrom-Konate represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
